title: Canada Labour Code RAG
question: Can Claude answer questions about the Canada Labour Code, with citations?
answer: Plain-language answers that cite the exact section of the law. In testing it cited the right section for 83% of questions and flagged both off-topic questions as not covered.

title: Steam indie RPG pricing
question: What should a small studio charge for an indie RPG on Steam?
answer: Indie RPGs priced £10–20 got the best reviews, clearly ahead of free games; the £20+ band was too uncertain to call.

title: RPG classifier eval
question: Can Claude spot an RPG from its store description?
answer: Claude agreed with Steam's tags on 76% of games. A looser prompt raised recall (60% → 72%) but added false alarms: a trade-off, not a win.

title: Telemetry audit case study (Ubisoft)
question: Why was game data going missing, and how do you fix it at the source?
answer: I audited every telemetry event against the tracking plan and fixed deprecated events with the producer, so daily data cleaning became rare.
